Welcome to the club, everybody. Here is how this works. We meet every Wednesday at five, always for one hour, and we always start the same way: everyone says three things about themselves and asks one question back. That is the rule. It sounds small, but it is the whole thing. This month we are trying something new. We are pairing every new member with somebody from a different country, so this week you are not talking to the whole group, you are talking to one person. Look at the message with your name on it. Your partner is already waiting for you.
